ops.title: TY_CONFIG_FILE=.claude/ty-quiet.toml (rules all=ignore) makes every in-session `ty check` a silent no-op in cc-transcript AND cc-steer — unset it for a real verdict
ops.body:
Both cc-transcript's and cc-steer's `.claude/settings.json` set `env.TY_CONFIG_FILE=.claude/ty-quiet.toml`, whose content is `[rules] all = "ignore"`. Every `ty check` run from inside a Claude Code session in these repos inherits it and reports "All checks passed!" no matter what — a silent no-op. CI never sets the var and runs the strict pyproject config.

Discovered 2026-07-20 shipping the cc-steer v14.6 migration: local ty "clean", CI red with 32 real narrowing errors (pytest cascade-skipped behind it).

**How to apply:** any ty verdict used as a gate must run `env -u TY_CONFIG_FILE uv run ty check <pkg>`. Never trust a bare in-session `ty check` in these repos. (Worth asking the user whether to scope or drop the settings var; until then, unset per-invocation.)
